verdict.rationale: Snowflake documents resource monitors that track warehouse credit usage and suspend a warehouse once it hits a credit limit. A hands-on user confirms setting one to stop all warehouses at 20 credits to keep costs from ballooning, and cost anomaly monitors plus notification integrations add alerting on top. Missing for 10: no evidence of idle-time auto-suspend settings for warehouses, no per-query timeout or cancellation of a single runaway query, and no evidence of a budgets feature (anomaly monitors are only in preview).
